summary: AIPilot.Initialize now flies a per-hull Mass-Space AI row (AIMassSpacePlanSO) in Mass-Space modes only: an ability cycle replacing the prefab list plus aggressiveness/throttle scales. First rows: Meerkat, Sparrow, Stoat, Urchin (and UrchinAutopilotConfig_Hijack/_BroodRush). Time and Charge modes keep the prefab values.
why: Most hulls ship AIPilot.abilities: [] so their AIs pressed no ability in Mass-Space games; trained in each hull's own games (plan steps mass-arcade, space-arcade).
